questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, ?
questions.x: Each term adds 3: 14 + 3 = 17.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, ?
questions.x: Each term adds 4: 21 + 4 = 25.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 9, 15, 21, 27, ?
questions.x: Each term adds 6: 27 + 6 = 33.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 8, 15, 22, 29, ?
questions.x: Each term adds 7: 29 + 7 = 36.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 4, 13, 22, 31, 40, ?
questions.x: Each term adds 9: 40 + 9 = 49.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 50, 46, 42, 38, 34, ?
questions.x: Each term subtracts 4: 34 - 4 = 30.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 30, 27, 24, 21, 18, ?
questions.x: Each term subtracts 3: 18 - 3 = 15.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 160, 80, 40, 20, ?
questions.x: Each term is divided by 2: 20 / 2 = 10.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, ?
questions.x: These are consecutive odd numbers, so the next is 9 + 2 = 11.

questions.q: What letter comes next: A, C, E, G, ?
questions.x: Each letter moves 2 places forward in the alphabet, so after G comes I.

questions.q: What letter comes next: B, E, H, K, ?
questions.x: Each letter moves 3 places forward in the alphabet, so after K comes N.

questions.q: What letter comes next: Z, X, V, T, ?
questions.x: Each letter moves 2 places back in the alphabet, so after T comes R.

questions.q: What letter comes next: C, G, K, O, ?
questions.x: Each letter moves 4 places forward in the alphabet, so after O comes S.

questions.q: What letter comes next: T, Q, N, K, ?
questions.x: Each letter moves 3 places back in the alphabet, so after K comes H.

questions.q: What letter comes next: G, J, M, P, ?
questions.x: Each letter moves 3 places forward in the alphabet, so after P comes S.

questions.q: What is 10% of 250?
What is 50% of 86?
What is 25% of 120?
What is 10% of 90?
What is 20% of 150?
What is 50% of 44?
What is 75% of 40?
What is 10% of 730?
There are 12 pencils in a pack. How many pencils are in 5 packs?
questions.x: 5 groups of 12: 5 x 12 = 60.

questions.q: A shirt costs $18. How much change do you get from a $50 bill?
Sam has 24 stickers and gives away a third of them. How many does he have left?
questions.x: A third of 24 is 8. 24 - 8 = 16 left.

questions.q: Four friends share 36 grapes equally. How many grapes does each get?
A ticket costs $7. How much do 6 tickets cost?
If 3 pens cost $6, how much do 5 pens cost at the same price?
questions.x: One pen costs $6 / 3 = $2. Five pens: 5 x 2 = $10.

questions.q: A rope 20 feet long is cut into pieces 4 feet long. How many pieces are there?
questions.x: 20 / 4 = 5 pieces.

questions.q: How many even numbers are there from 1 to 20?
questions.x: Every second number is even, so half of 20 gives 10.

questions.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 4 days from now?
questions.x: Count 4 days forward from Wednesday: Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

questions.q: Today is Friday. What day of the week will it be 3 days from now?
questions.x: Count 3 days forward from Friday: Saturday, Sunday, Monday.

questions.q: Today is Sunday. What day of the week will it be 6 days from now?
questions.x: Count 6 days forward from Sunday: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.

questions.q: Today is Thursday. What day was it 2 days ago?
questions.x: Count 2 back from Thursday: that gives Tuesday.

questions.q: Today is Tuesday. What day was it 3 days ago?
questions.x: Count 3 back from Tuesday: that gives Saturday.

questions.q: Today is Monday. What day was it 1 day ago?
questions.x: Count 1 back from Monday: that gives Sunday.

questions.q: How many days are there in 3 weeks?
questions.x: A week has 7 days, and 3 x 7 = 21.

questions.q: What month comes 4 months after October?
questions.x: After October: November, December, January, February.

questions.q: If the 5th of a month is a Tuesday, what weekday is the 13th?
questions.x: 13 is 8 days after 5: one week plus 1 day, so Tuesday plus 1 is Wednesday.

questions.q: A show starts at 3:15 and lasts 90 minutes. At what time does it end?
questions.x: 90 minutes added to 3:15 gives 4:45.

questions.q: A show starts at 4:30 and lasts 45 minutes. At what time does it end?
questions.x: 45 minutes added to 4:30 gives 5:15.

questions.q: A show starts at 7:20 and lasts 60 minutes. At what time does it end?
questions.x: 60 minutes added to 7:20 gives 8:20.

questions.q: A show starts at 1:45 and lasts 30 minutes. At what time does it end?
questions.x: 30 minutes added to 1:45 gives 2:15.

questions.q: A show starts at 10:10 and lasts 50 minutes. At what time does it end?
questions.x: 50 minutes added to 10:10 gives 11:00.

questions.q: How many hours pass between 9 AM and 5 PM on the same day?
questions.x: From 9 to 12 is 3 hours and from 12 to 5 is 5 hours: 3 + 5 = 8.

questions.q: How many minutes are there between 2:10 PM and 3:00 PM?
questions.x: From 2:10 to 3:00 is 60 - 10 = 50 minutes.

questions.q: What time is it 2 hours after 11 AM?
questions.x: 11 AM plus 1 hour is noon, plus 1 more hour is 1 PM.

questions.q: How many minutes are in 2 and a half hours?
questions.x: 2 x 60 = 120, plus half an hour (30) = 150.

questions.q: How many centimeters are in 3 meters?
questions.x: 1 meter = 100 cm, so 3 x 100 = 300.

questions.q: How many days are in 6 weeks?
How many feet are in 4 yards?
questions.x: 1 yard = 3 feet, so 4 x 3 = 12.

questions.q: How many seconds are in 5 minutes?
How many grams are in 2 kilograms?
How many pints are in 3 quarts, if 1 quart is 2 pints?
How many legs do 3 dogs and 2 birds have altogether?
questions.x: Dogs: 3 x 4 = 12. Birds: 2 x 2 = 4. Total 16.

questions.q: How many sides do 2 triangles and 1 square have in total?
questions.x: Triangles: 2 x 3 = 6. Square: 4. Total 10.

questions.q: How many wheels are on 4 bicycles and 2 cars?
questions.x: Bicycles: 4 x 2 = 8. Cars: 2 x 4 = 8. Total 16.

questions.q: How many fingers are on 6 hands?
Ann is taller than Bo. Bo is taller than Cy. Who is the tallest?
questions.x: Ann > Bo > Cy, so Ann is tallest.

questions.q: Max is older than Lee. Kim is younger than Lee. Who is the youngest?
questions.x: Max > Lee > Kim in age, so Kim is youngest.

questions.q: Zed is faster than Jay. Lou is slower than Jay. Who is the slowest?
questions.x: Zed > Jay > Lou in speed, so Lou is slowest.

questions.q: Pat has more coins than Dan. Dan has more coins than Eve. Who has the fewest?
questions.x: Pat > Dan > Eve, so Eve has the fewest.

questions.q: Ann is heavier than Joe. Joe is heavier than Sue. Who is the lightest?
questions.x: Ann > Joe > Sue, so Sue is lightest.

questions.q: Joy finished before Ray. Ray finished before Sue. Who finished in the middle?
questions.x: The order is Joy, Ray, Sue, so Ray is in the middle.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Apple, Carrot, Banana, Grape?
questions.x: Apple, banana and grape are fruits; a carrot is a vegetable.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Sparrow, Dog, Cat, Horse?
questions.x: Dog, cat and horse are mammals; a sparrow is a bird.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Red, Blue, Green, Square?
questions.x: Red, blue and green are colors; a square is a shape.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out: 2, 4, 6, 9?
questions.x: 2, 4 and 6 are even; 9 is odd.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9?
questions.x: 3, 5 and 7 are prime numbers; 9 = 3 x 3 is not.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Car, Bus, Train, Chair?
questions.x: Car, bus and train are vehicles; a chair is furniture.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Penny, Dime, Ruler, Nickel?
questions.x: Penny, dime and nickel are coins; a ruler is not.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out: Eagle, Hawk, Owl, Bat?
questions.x: Eagle, hawk and owl are birds; a bat is a mammal.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Bread, Water, Milk, Juice?
questions.x: Water, milk and juice are drinks; bread is a solid food.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out: 16, 25, 36, 40?
questions.x: 16, 25 and 36 are perfect squares (4x4, 5x5, 6x6); 40 is not.

questions.q: Hot is to cold as up is to what?
questions.x: Hot and cold are opposites, and the opposite of up is down.

questions.q: Finger is to hand as toe is to what?
questions.x: A finger is part of a hand; a toe is part of a foot.

questions.q: Bird is to nest as bee is to what?
questions.x: A bird lives in a nest; a bee lives in a hive.

questions.q: Pen is to write as knife is to what?
questions.x: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut.

questions.q: Fish is to swim as bird is to what?
questions.x: A fish moves by swimming; a bird moves by flying.

questions.q: Eye is to see as ear is to what?
questions.x: The eye is for seeing; the ear is for hearing.

questions.q: Puppy is to dog as kitten is to what?
questions.x: A puppy is a young dog; a kitten is a young cat.

questions.q: Teacher is to school as doctor is to what?
questions.x: A teacher works at a school; a doctor works at a hospital.

questions.q: Slow is to fast as weak is to what?
questions.x: Slow and fast are opposites, and so are weak and strong.

questions.q: Glove is to hand as sock is to what?
questions.x: A glove covers a hand; a sock covers a foot.

questions.q: A farmer has 10 sheep. All but 3 run away. How many sheep are left?
questions.x: "All but 3" means 3 stay. So 3 are left.

questions.q: Ann's father has 5 daughters: Nana, Nene, Nini, Nono and a fifth. What is the fifth one's name?
questions.x: Ann's father has five daughters, and Ann is one of them, so the fifth is Ann.

questions.q: Which weighs more: a pound of feathers or a pound of bricks?
questions.x: Both are one pound, so they weigh the same.

questions.q: If a red house is made of red bricks, what is a greenhouse made of?
questions.x: A greenhouse is a glass building for growing plants; it is not green-colored.

questions.q: Tom is 8 and his sister is 4 years older. How old will she be when Tom is 12?
questions.x: She is 4 years older now (12) and always will be, so when Tom is 12 she is 16.

questions.q: How many letters are in the word that names the number after six?
questions.x: The number after six is seven, which has 5 letters.

questions.q: If you rearrange the letters of "TAC", which animal do you get?
questions.x: T, A, C can be rearranged to C-A-T, which is a cat.

questions.q: If the letters A, B, C, D, E are numbered 1 to 5, what is the number for D?
What is the first letter of the word that comes last in the alphabet: dog, cat, bird, fish?
questions.x: In alphabetical order the last word is fish, and its first letter is F.

questions.q: What is the sum of the largest and the smallest of 0.5, 0.25, 0.75 and 0.6?
questions.x: The largest is 0.75 and the smallest is 0.25. 0.75 + 0.25 = 1.

questions.q: A square has a side of 5 cm. What is the distance around it?
questions.x: A square has 4 equal sides: 4 x 5 = 20 cm.

questions.q: How much larger is 4 x 7 than 20 + 5?
A clock shows 6:00. What number is the hour hand pointing at?
questions.x: At 6:00 the hour hand points at the 6.

questions.q: How many months in a year have 30 days?
questions.x: April, June, September and November have 30 days.

questions.q: Counting by 5s from 5, what is the 8th number?
questions.x: The nth number is 5 x n, so the 8th is 5 x 8 = 40.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 50, 4, 45, 7, 40, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series. One starts at 1 and adds 3 each time; the other starts at 50 and subtracts 5 each time. The next term is 10.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 2, 7, 8, 11, 14, 15, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series. One starts at 3 and adds 4 each time; the other starts at 2 and adds 6 each time. The next term is 20.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 6, 60, 12, 54, 18, 48, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series. One starts at 6 and adds 6 each time; the other starts at 60 and subtracts 6 each time. The next term is 24.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 4, 6, 9, 13, 18, ?
questions.x: The gaps grow by 1 each time: 1, 2, 3... The next gap is 6, so 18 + 6 = 24.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 3, 7, 15, 31, ?
questions.x: Each term is the previous x 2 plus 1: 31 x 2 + 1 = 63.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 14, 41, 122, ?
questions.x: Each term is the previous x 3 minus 1: 122 x 3 - 1 = 365.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 5, 7, 11, 19, 35, ?
questions.x: Each term is the previous x 2 minus 3: 35 x 2 - 3 = 67.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ?
questions.x: Each term is the sum of the two before it: 8 + 13 = 21.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 4, 7, 11, 18, 29, 47, ?
questions.x: Each term is the sum of the two before it: 29 + 47 = 76.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.x: Each term is a square plus 1: 1+1, 4+1, 9+1, 16+1, 25+1. The next is 36 + 1 = 37.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ?
questions.x: These are the prime numbers in order. The next prime after 11 is 13.

questions.q: What letter comes next: A, B, D, G, K, P, ?
questions.x: Positions move by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 so the next step is 6: P goes to V.

questions.q: What letter comes next: C, D, F, I, M, ?
questions.x: Positions move by 1, 2, 3, 4 so the next step is 5: M goes to R.

questions.q: What letter comes next: E, G, J, N, S, ?
questions.x: Positions move by 2, 3, 4, 5 so the next step is 6: S goes to Y.

questions.q: What letter comes next: A, Z, B, Y, C, X, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series: A, B, C go forward and Z, Y, X go backward. The next term is D.

questions.q: What comes next: A1, B2, C3, D4, ?
questions.x: Letters go A, B, C, D, E and numbers go 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

questions.q: What comes next: AB, CD, EF, GH, ?
questions.x: Each pair continues the alphabet from where the last pair stopped: after GH comes IJ.

questions.q: A $80 jacket is 25% off. What is the sale price?
A $50 game is on sale for 40% off. What do you pay?
A phone costs $200 plus 10% tax. What is the total?
questions.x: 10% of 200 is 20, so the total is 200 + 20 = 220.

questions.q: What is 15% of 60?
20% of what number is 12?
questions.x: 20% is one fifth. So the number is 12 x 5 = 60.

questions.q: 30% of what number is 45?
In a class of 40 students, 35% are boys. How many girls are there?
A town of 2,000 people grows by 5%. What is the new population?
A test has 50 questions. Mia gets 80% right. How many does she get wrong?
What percent of 80 is 20?
A shirt is $40. A coupon takes off 10%, then a $2 discount is applied. What is the final price?
Four numbers have a mean of 12. Three of them are 10, 12 and 14. What is the fourth?
questions.x: Total = 4 x 12 = 48. The three add up to 36, so the fourth is 48 - 36 = 12.

questions.q: The mean of 5 numbers is 8. Four of them add up to 31. What is the fifth?
What is the mean of 4, 8, 9 and 15?
questions.x: The sum is 36, and 36 / 4 = 9.

questions.q: Scores of 70, 80 and 90 have been recorded. What score on a fourth test makes the mean 85?
questions.x: Needed total = 4 x 85 = 340. Current total is 240, so you need 100.

questions.q: How long does it take to drive 150 miles at 50 miles per hour?
questions.x: Time = distance / speed = 150 / 50 = 3 hours.

questions.q: A cyclist rides 12 miles per hour for 2.5 hours. How far does she go?
questions.x: Distance = speed x time = 12 x 2.5 = 30 miles.

questions.q: A train goes 240 miles in 4 hours. How far does it go in 6 hours at the same speed?
questions.x: Speed = 240 / 4 = 60 mph. In 6 hours: 6 x 60 = 360 miles.

questions.q: Walking at 4 mph, how many minutes does it take to walk 2 miles?
questions.x: 2 miles / 4 mph = 0.5 hour = 30 minutes.

questions.q: If 4 workers paint a fence in 6 hours, how long would 8 workers take at the same rate?
questions.x: Twice the workers means half the time: 6 / 2 = 3 hours.

questions.q: A tap fills a 60-liter tank at 5 liters per minute. How many minutes to fill it?
questions.x: 60 / 5 = 12 minutes.

questions.q: If today is Tuesday, which weekday will it be in 30 days?
questions.x: 30 = 4 weeks plus 2 days. Tuesday plus 2 days is Thursday.

questions.q: If today is Thursday, which weekday will it be in 45 days?
questions.x: 45 = 6 weeks plus 3 days. Thursday plus 3 days is Sunday.

questions.q: If today is Monday, which weekday will it be in 100 days?
questions.x: 100 = 14 weeks plus 2 days. Monday plus 2 days is Wednesday.

questions.q: If today is Saturday, which weekday will it be in 20 days?
questions.x: 20 = 2 weeks plus 6 days. Saturday plus 6 days is Friday.

questions.q: If today is Wednesday, which weekday will it be in 59 days?
questions.x: 59 = 8 weeks plus 3 days. Wednesday plus 3 days is Saturday.

questions.q: If today is Friday, which weekday will it be in 52 days?
questions.x: 52 = 7 weeks plus 3 days. Friday plus 3 days is Monday.

questions.q: In a non-leap year, January 1 is a Wednesday. What day is February 1?
questions.x: January has 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.

questions.q: If March 1 is a Monday in a non-leap year, what day is April 1?
questions.x: March has 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. Monday + 3 = Thursday.

questions.q: How many days are there from March 3 to March 29, counting March 29 but not March 3?
The day before the day after tomorrow is Friday. What day is today?
questions.x: "Day before the day after tomorrow" is tomorrow. Tomorrow is Friday, so today is Thursday.

questions.q: A train leaves at 10:40 AM and the trip takes 2 hours 35 minutes. When does it arrive?
What is the angle between the hour and minute hands at exactly 3:00?
questions.x: The 12 hour marks split 360 degrees into 30 each. 3 marks apart = 90 degrees.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands at exactly 6:00?
questions.x: At 6:00 the hands point in opposite directions: 6 x 30 = 180 degrees.

questions.q: What time is 14:45 on a 24-hour clock in 12-hour time?
How many minutes are there from 8:50 AM to 11:20 AM?
questions.x: 8:50 to 11:00 is 130 minutes, plus 20 = 150.

questions.q: A clock chimes once at 1 o'clock, twice at 2 o'clock, and so on. How many chimes from 1 to 4 o'clock inclusive?
A clock loses 5 minutes every hour. After 6 real hours, how many minutes behind is it?
questions.x: 6 x 5 = 30 minutes.

questions.q: How many times a day (24 hours) does the minute hand point straight up at 12?
questions.x: It points at 12 once per hour, so 24 times.

questions.q: 5 people each shake hands once with every other person. How many handshakes happen?
questions.x: Each of 5 shakes 4 hands, but each handshake is counted twice: 5 x 4 / 2 = 10.

questions.q: 8 people each shake hands once with every other person. How many handshakes happen?
questions.x: Each of 8 shakes 7 hands, but each handshake is counted twice: 8 x 7 / 2 = 28.

questions.q: 10 people each shake hands once with every other person. How many handshakes happen?
questions.x: Each of 10 shakes 9 hands, but each handshake is counted twice: 10 x 9 / 2 = 45.

questions.q: How many diagonals does a square have?
questions.x: A square has 2 diagonals, one joining each pair of opposite corners.

questions.q: How many different 2-letter orders can be made from the letters A, B and C using each letter once?
questions.x: There are 3 choices for the first letter and 2 for the second: 3 x 2 = 6.

questions.q: A shirt comes in 3 colors and 4 sizes. How many different shirts are there?
questions.x: 3 x 4 = 12 combinations.

questions.q: If BED is written as CFE, how is CAT written in the same code?
questions.x: The code moves each letter 1 place forward in the alphabet, so CAT becomes DBU.

questions.q: If BED is written as DGF, how is DOG written in the same code?
questions.x: The code moves each letter 2 places forward in the alphabet, so DOG becomes FQI.

questions.q: If BED is written as CFE, how is SUN written in the same code?
questions.x: The code moves each letter 1 place forward in the alphabet, so SUN becomes TVO.

questions.q: If BED is written as EHG, how is MAP written in the same code?
questions.x: The code moves each letter 3 places forward in the alphabet, so MAP becomes PDS.

questions.q: If A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on, what is the sum of the letters in the word "CAB"?
If A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on, what is the value of the word "BED"?
If A=1, B=2 and so on, which letter has the value equal to 3 times the value of E?
questions.x: E = 5, 3 x 5 = 15, and the 15th letter is O.

questions.q: Ann is 3 times as old as Ben. In 6 years the sum of their ages will be 52. How old is Ben now?
questions.x: Now: Ben b, Ann 3b. In 6 years: (3b+6)+(b+6)=52, 4b=40, b=10.

questions.q: A mother is 27 years older than her son. In 3 years she will be 4 times his age. How old is the son now?
Two sisters are 4 years apart. Their ages add up to 20. How old is the older sister?
questions.x: Ages x and x+4: 2x+4 = 20, x = 8. The older is 12.

questions.q: Dan is twice as old as his brother. Together they are 18. How old is Dan?
questions.x: Brother b, Dan 2b: 3b = 18, b = 6, Dan = 12.

questions.q: Ann is taller than Bo. Dee is shorter than Cy. Bo is taller than Cy. Who is the second tallest?
questions.x: The clues give the chain Ann > Bo > Cy > Dee (taller). The second tallest is Bo.

questions.q: Kim is older than Max. Lee is younger than Raj. Max is older than Raj. Who is the youngest?
questions.x: The clues give the chain Kim > Max > Raj > Lee (older). The youngest is Lee.

questions.q: Ian is faster than Fay. Pat is slower than Zoe. Fay is faster than Zoe. Who is the second fastest?
questions.x: The clues give the chain Ian > Fay > Zoe > Pat (faster). The second fastest is Fay.

questions.q: Jon is heavier than Ivy. Gus is lighter than Hal. Ivy is heavier than Hal. Who is the lightest?
questions.x: The clues give the chain Jon > Ivy > Hal > Gus (heavier). The lightest is Gus.

questions.q: All zibs are yons. All yons are quas. Which must be true of every zib?
questions.x: Zib -> yon -> qua, so every zib is a qua.

questions.q: All cats purr. Felix is a cat. What follows?
questions.x: Every cat purrs and Felix is a cat, so Felix purrs. The reverse is not stated.

questions.q: If it rains, the match is canceled. The match was not canceled. What can we conclude?
questions.x: If rain always cancels the match, then no cancellation means no rain.

questions.q: No fish can fly. A trout is a fish. What follows?
questions.x: No fish can fly, and a trout is a fish, so a trout cannot fly.

questions.q: Three boxes hold a total of 30 apples. Box 1 has 4 more than box 2, and box 2 has 4 more than box 3. How many are in box 1?
questions.x: Box 3 = x, box 2 = x+4, box 1 = x+8: 3x+12 = 30, x = 6, so box 1 has 14.

questions.q: Only one of three keys opens a lock. You have tried two wrong keys. What is the chance the third key works?
questions.x: Only one key works, and the other two are ruled out, so the third must work.

questions.q: A snail climbs 3 feet up a 10-foot wall each day and slips 2 feet at night. On which day does it reach the top?
questions.x: It gains 1 ft per full day. After 7 days it is at 7 ft. On day 8 it climbs 3 to reach 10 ft before slipping.

questions.q: A rope is cut into 4 equal pieces with 3 cuts. How many cuts make 7 equal pieces?
questions.x: Pieces = cuts + 1 for a rope, so 7 pieces need 6 cuts.

questions.q: A fence has posts every 5 feet in a straight line, 8 posts in all. How long is the fence?
questions.x: 8 posts have 7 gaps. 7 x 5 = 35 feet.

questions.q: How many months of the year have at least 28 days?
questions.x: Every month has 28 or more days (February has 28 or 29).

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern: 2, 4, 3, 6, 5, 10, 9, ?
questions.x: The series alternates: x2 then -1. 9 x 2 = 18.

questions.q: How many letters are between the first letter and the last letter of the word QUESTION?
questions.x: QUESTION has 8 letters. Leave out the first and last: 8 - 2 = 6.

questions.q: The letters of the alphabet are numbered 1 to 26. Which letter is exactly halfway between D and N?
questions.x: D = 4, N = 14, the midpoint is 9, which is I.

questions.q: Pen is to ink as car is to what?
questions.x: Ink is what a pen uses up to work; fuel is what a car uses up to run.
8, 27, 64 and 125 are cubes (2, 3, 4, 5 cubed). 50 is not a cube.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out: 21, 35, 49, 51, 63?
questions.x: 21, 35, 49 and 63 are multiples of 7. 51 is not (7 x 7 = 49, 7 x 8 = 56).

questions.q: Which is the odd one out: 3, 6, 9, 14, 15?
questions.x: 3, 6, 9 and 15 are multiples of 3. 14 is not.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out: 12, 18, 24, 30, 35?
questions.x: 12, 18, 24 and 30 are multiples of 6 (and even). 35 is not.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: April, June, January, September?
questions.x: April, June and September have 30 days. January has 31.

questions.q: Which position is the odd one out: Square, Cube, Circle, Triangle?
questions.x: The others are flat 2D shapes. A cube is a solid 3D shape.

questions.q: Cow is to calf as sheep is to what?
questions.x: A calf is the young of a cow; a lamb is the young of a sheep.

questions.q: Page is to book as brick is to what?
questions.x: A page is one unit that makes up a book; a brick makes up a wall.

questions.q: Hand is to arm as foot is to what?
questions.x: A hand is at the end of an arm; a foot is at the end of a leg.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 2, 5, 4, 7, 8, 9, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series: one adds 2 each time (3, 5...), the other multiplies by 2 (2, 4...). The next term is 16.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 10, 1, 15, 2, 20, 4, 25, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series: one adds 5 each time (10, 15...), the other multiplies by 2 (1, 2...). The next term is 8.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 6, 10, 10, 20, 14, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series: one adds 4 each time (2, 6...), the other multiplies by 2 (5, 10...). The next term is 40.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 20, 1, 17, 3, 14, 9, 11, ?
questions.x: Two interleaved series: one subtracts 3 each time (20, 17...), the other multiplies by 3 (1, 3...). The next term is 27.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 4, 6, 10, 18, 34, ?
questions.x: The gaps are 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, doubling. The next gap is 32. 34 + 32 = 66.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 3, 6, 11, 18, 29, ?
questions.x: The gaps are the primes 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. The next prime is 13. 29 + 13 = 42.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 0, 1, 9, 36, 100, ?
questions.x: The gaps are 1, 8, 27, 64 (cubes), so the next is 125. 100 + 125 = 225.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 3, 9, 11, 33, 35, 105, ?
questions.x: The rules alternate: add 2, then multiply by 3. After x3 comes +2: 105 + 2 = 107.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 10, 13, 26, 29, 58, ?
questions.x: The rules alternate: add 3, then multiply by 2. After x2 comes +3: 58 + 3 = 61.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 5, 10, 14, 28, 32, 64, ?
questions.x: The rules alternate: add 4, then multiply by 2. After x2 comes +4: 64 + 4 = 68.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 4, 27, 16, 125, 36, ?
questions.x: Odd positions are cubes (1, 27, 125, next 343); even positions are squares (4, 16, 36).

questions.q: What letter comes next: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.x: Steps are +2, +3, +4, +5, so the next is +6. O is 15, and 15 + 6 = 21, which is U.

questions.q: What letter comes next: Z, X, U, Q, L, ?
questions.x: Steps are -2, -3, -4, -5, so the next is -6. L is 12, and 12 - 6 = 6, which is F.

questions.q: What comes next: J, F, M, A, M, J, ?
questions.x: These are the first letters of the months: January, February, ... June, then July.

questions.q: What comes next: O, T, T, F, F, S, S, ?
questions.x: First letters of One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, so next is Eight, E.

questions.q: A price goes up 10% and then down 10%. Compared with the start, the final price is what?
questions.x: Factor is (1+0.1) x (1-0.1) = 1 - 0.01 so it is 1% lower.

questions.q: A price goes up 20% and then down 20%. Compared with the start, the final price is what?
questions.x: Factor is (1+0.2) x (1-0.2) = 1 - 0.04 so it is 4% lower.

questions.q: A price goes up 30% and then down 30%. Compared with the start, the final price is what?
questions.x: Factor is (1+0.3) x (1-0.3) = 1 - 0.09 so it is 9% lower.

questions.q: A coat is 20% off, then an extra 10% off the sale price. What is the total discount?
questions.x: You pay 80% x 90% = 72% of the original, so the discount is 28%, not 30%.

questions.q: A coat is 30% off, then an extra 20% off the sale price. What is the total discount?
questions.x: You pay 70% x 80% = 56% of the original, so the discount is 44%, not 50%.

questions.q: A coat is 50% off, then an extra 50% off the sale price. What is the total discount?
questions.x: You pay 50% x 50% = 25% of the original, so the discount is 75%, not 100%.

questions.q: A coat is 25% off, then an extra 20% off the sale price. What is the total discount?
questions.x: You pay 75% x 80% = 60% of the original, so the discount is 40%, not 45%.

questions.q: A number is increased by 50%, then the result is decreased by 50%. The result is 75. What was the original number?
questions.x: 1.5 x 0.5 = 0.75 of the original, and 75 is 0.75 of 100.

questions.q: After a 20% discount a book costs $48. What was the original price?
questions.x: $48 is 80% of the original. 48 / 0.8 = 60.

questions.q: A store marks up cost by 25% to get a price of $75. What was the cost?
questions.x: Price = 1.25 x cost, so cost = 75 / 1.25 = 60.

questions.q: A is 20% larger than B. B is what percent smaller than A?
questions.x: A = 1.2B, so the gap 0.2B is 0.2/1.2 = 1/6, about 16.7% of A.

questions.q: The sum of three consecutive integers is 72. What is the largest?
questions.x: Middle = 72 / 3 = 24, so the numbers are 23, 24, 25.

questions.q: The sum of four consecutive even numbers is 100. What is the smallest?
The sum of three consecutive odd numbers is 99. What is the middle one?
questions.x: The middle one is the mean: 99 / 3 = 33 (numbers 31, 33, 35).

questions.q: The product of two consecutive positive integers is 156. What is their sum?
Boys and girls in a club are in the ratio 3:5 and there are 40 members. How many girls are there?
questions.x: The ratio has 8 parts; 40 / 8 = 5 per part; girls = 5 x 5 = 25.

questions.q: Red and blue marbles are in the ratio 2:7. There are 63 marbles. How many are red?
questions.x: 2 + 7 = 9 parts, 63 / 9 = 7 per part, red = 2 x 7 = 14.

questions.q: A recipe uses flour and sugar in the ratio 5:2. With 8 cups of sugar, how many cups of flour?
questions.x: Sugar 8 is 4 times 2, so flour is 4 x 5 = 20.

questions.q: Pump A fills a pool in 6 hours and pump B in 3 hours. Working together, how long do they take?
questions.x: Rates: 1/6 + 1/3 = 9/18 of the pool per hour, so the time is 18/9 = 2 hours.

questions.q: Pump A fills a pool in 12 hours and pump B in 4 hours. Working together, how long do they take?
questions.x: Rates: 1/12 + 1/4 = 16/48 of the pool per hour, so the time is 48/16 = 3 hours.

questions.q: Pump A fills a pool in 10 hours and pump B in 15 hours. Working together, how long do they take?
questions.x: Rates: 1/10 + 1/15 = 25/150 of the pool per hour, so the time is 150/25 = 6 hours.

questions.q: Two trains 300 miles apart head toward each other at 40 and 60 mph. After how many hours do they meet?
questions.x: They close 40 + 60 = 100 miles each hour. 300 / 100 = 3 hours.

questions.q: Two cyclists start 90 km apart and ride toward each other at 12 and 18 km/h. How many hours until they meet?
questions.x: The gap closes at 12 + 18 = 30 km/h. 90 / 30 = 3 hours.

questions.q: A runner at 9 mph starts 6 miles behind another at 6 mph, both going the same way. How many hours until she catches up?
questions.x: She gains 9 - 6 = 3 mph. 6 / 3 = 2 hours.

questions.q: A car drives to a town at 30 mph and returns the same road at 60 mph. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
questions.x: Average speed = total distance / total time = 2ab/(a+b) = 2x30x60/90 = 40 mph, not the simple mean.

questions.q: A car drives to a town at 40 mph and returns the same road at 60 mph. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
questions.x: Average speed = total distance / total time = 2ab/(a+b) = 2x40x60/100 = 48 mph, not the simple mean.

questions.q: A car drives to a town at 20 mph and returns the same road at 30 mph. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
questions.x: Average speed = total distance / total time = 2ab/(a+b) = 2x20x30/50 = 24 mph, not the simple mean.

questions.q: How many squares of all sizes are in a 3 by 3 grid of small squares?
questions.x: Count by size: 9 of size 1, 4 of size 2, 1 of size 3. Total 14.

questions.q: How many squares of all sizes are in a 5 by 5 grid of small squares?
questions.x: Count by size: 25 of size 1, 16 of size 2, 9 of size 3, 4 of size 4, 1 of size 5. Total 55.

questions.q: How many diagonals does a polygon with 6 sides have?
questions.x: Each corner joins to 3 others, and each diagonal is counted twice: 6 x 3 / 2 = 9.

questions.q: How many diagonals does a polygon with 8 sides have?
questions.x: Each corner joins to 5 others, and each diagonal is counted twice: 8 x 5 / 2 = 20.

questions.q: In how many different orders can 4 books be arranged on a shelf?
In how many ways can 5 people be seated in a row?
How many different ways can you choose 2 people from a group of 6?
questions.x: Choose in order: 6 x 5 = 30, but each pair is counted twice, so 15.

questions.q: A binary number is read right to left as 1, 2, 4, 8. What is 1011 in ordinary numbers?
What is 110 in binary, written as an ordinary number?
What is the units digit of 7 x 7 x 7 x 7?
What is the last digit of 2 to the power 10 (ten 2s multiplied)?
questions.x: Last digits repeat 2, 4, 8, 6. Power 10 is position 2 in the cycle: 4. (2^10 = 1024)

questions.q: What is the last digit of 3 to the power 5?
In a class of 30, 18 play soccer, 15 play chess and 5 do neither. How many play both?
questions.x: 25 play at least one. 18 + 15 = 33, so 33 - 25 = 8 play both.

questions.q: In a class of 40, 26 play soccer, 20 play chess and 3 do neither. How many play both?
questions.x: 37 play at least one. 26 + 20 = 46, so 46 - 37 = 9 play both.

questions.q: In a class of 50, 30 play soccer, 28 play chess and 8 do neither. How many play both?
questions.x: 42 play at least one. 30 + 28 = 58, so 58 - 42 = 16 play both.

questions.q: Starting on a Wednesday, which weekday comes 100 days later?
questions.x: 100 = 14 weeks + 2 days. Wednesday plus 2 is Friday.

questions.q: In 2024 (a leap year) January 1 was a Monday. What day was December 31, 2024?
questions.x: Dec 31 is 365 days after Jan 1. 365 = 52 weeks + 1 day. Monday plus 1 is Tuesday.

questions.q: If June 10 is a Thursday, what day is August 10 in the same year?
questions.x: June 10 to Aug 10 is 20 + 31 + 10 = 61 days = 8 weeks + 5 days. Thursday + 5 = Tuesday.

questions.q: Counting back 100 days from a Friday, which weekday do you reach?
questions.x: 100 = 14 weeks + 2 days. Friday minus 2 days is Wednesday.

questions.q: Today is Monday. What day will it be 1,000 days from now?
questions.x: 1,000 = 142 x 7 + 6. Monday plus 6 days is Sunday.

questions.q: How many days are there from January 1 to March 1 in a leap year, not counting the end date?
questions.x: January 31 + February 29 = 60 days.

questions.q: If the 3rd of a month is a Sunday, on which date is the third Friday?
questions.x: The 3rd is Sunday, so the first Friday is the 8th. Fridays fall on the 8th, 15th and 22nd, so the third is the 22nd.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands at 2:30?
questions.x: Hour hand: 30x2 + 0.5x30 = 75 degrees. Minute hand: 6x30 = 180. The smaller gap is 105 degrees.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands at 3:40?
questions.x: Hour hand: 30x3 + 0.5x40 = 110 degrees. Minute hand: 6x40 = 240. The smaller gap is 130 degrees.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands at 9:15?
questions.x: Hour hand: 30x9 + 0.5x15 = 277.5 degrees. Minute hand: 6x15 = 90. The smaller gap is 172.5 degrees.

questions.q: How many times do the hour and minute hands overlap in a 12-hour period (counting 12:00 once)?
questions.x: The minute hand laps the hour hand 11 times in 12 hours.

questions.q: A clock gains 3 minutes every hour. It is set right at noon. What time does it show at 6 PM real time?
questions.x: 6 hours x 3 minutes = 18 extra minutes, so 6:18 PM.

questions.q: A bag has 4 red and 6 blue marbles. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the chance both are red?
questions.x: First red: 4/10. Then 3/9. Multiply: 12/90 = 2/15.

questions.q: A bag has 5 red and 7 blue marbles. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the chance both are red?
questions.x: First red: 5/12. Then 4/11. Multiply: 20/132 = 5/33.

questions.q: Two fair dice are rolled. What is the chance their sum is 7?
questions.x: Six of the 36 outcomes sum to 7 (1+6, 2+5, 3+4 and reverses): 6/36 = 1/6.

questions.q: Two fair dice are rolled. What is the chance their sum is 10?
questions.x: The outcomes are 4+6, 5+5, 6+4: 3 of 36 = 1/12.

questions.q: A fair coin is flipped 3 times. What is the chance of exactly 2 heads?
questions.x: There are 8 outcomes and 3 have exactly two heads (HHT, HTH, THH): 3/8.

questions.q: A coin lands heads 5 times in a row. For a fair coin, what is the chance the next flip is heads?
questions.x: Flips are independent, so each flip is 1/2 regardless of the past.

questions.q: A box holds 3 red and 2 blue cards. One card is drawn at random. What is the chance it is blue?
questions.x: Total 5 cards, 2 are blue: 2/5.

questions.q: Three boxes are labeled Apples, Oranges and Mixed, all wrongly. A fruit from the Mixed box is an apple. What is in the Oranges box?
questions.x: The Mixed label is wrong, so that box is all apples. The Oranges box cannot be oranges or apples, so it is mixed.

questions.q: A says "B lies." B says "C lies." C says "A and B both lie." Who tells the truth?
questions.x: If B tells the truth, C lies and A lies: consistent (C lies, A lies). Other options fail.

questions.q: Five runners finish. Ana beat Bo, Bo beat Cy, Cy beat Dee and Eli beat Ana. Who came third?
questions.x: The order is Eli, Ana, Bo, Cy, Dee. Third is Bo.

questions.q: In a 4-floor building (floor 1 is the lowest), Ann lives above Bo, Cy lives below Bo and Dee lives above Ann. Who lives on floor 2?
questions.x: From bottom to top: Cy, Bo, Ann, Dee. Floor 2 is Bo.

questions.q: Knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. A says "B is a knave", and B says "A and I are both knights." What are A and B?
questions.x: If B were a knight, B's claim makes A a knight too, but A says B is a knave: contradiction. So B is a knave, and A is truthful.

questions.q: Ann, Ben and Cal each own one pet: a cat, a dog or a fish. Ann is allergic to fur. Ben does not own a dog. Who owns the dog?
questions.x: Ann has the fish (allergic to fur). Ben does not have the dog, so he has the cat. Cal has the dog.

questions.q: Sue is taller than Tim. Tim is taller than Uma. Vic is shorter than Sue but taller than Tim. Who is second tallest?
questions.x: Sue > Vic > Tim > Uma, so Vic is second.

questions.q: Four people stand in a line. Ann is not first or last. Ben is first. Cal is not next to Ben. Cal is not last. Who is last?
questions.x: Ben is first. Cal is not second, not last, so Cal is third. Ann is not last, so Ann is second and Dee is last.

questions.q: There are 8 coins and one is heavier. With a balance scale, what is the fewest weighings that always find the heavy coin?
questions.x: Weigh 3 vs 3. If they balance, the heavy coin is among 2 left. Else it is in the heavy 3. One more weighing finds it among 3. Total 2.

questions.q: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
Lily pads double every day and cover a lake on day 48. On which day did they cover half the lake?
questions.x: Doubling means the day before full coverage is half coverage: day 47.

questions.q: If 3 machines make 3 widgets in 8 minutes, how many seconds do 90 machines need to make 90 widgets?
questions.x: Each machine makes 1 widget in 8 minutes, so 90 machines make 90 in 8 minutes = 480 seconds.

questions.q: In a race you overtake the runner in second place. What place are you in now?
questions.x: You take the position of the runner you passed: 2nd.

questions.q: Two fathers and two sons share 3 apples, one each, with none left over. How is that possible?
questions.x: The grandfather and father are fathers; the father and son are sons. That is only 3 people.

questions.q: A doctor gives you 3 pills and says to take one every half hour. How long do they last?
questions.x: Take one now, one after 30 min, one after 60 min: 1 hour.

questions.q: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 die. How many are left?
questions.x: "All but 9" means 9 survive.

questions.q: What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
questions.x: "Minute" has one M, "moment" has two, and "thousand years" has none.

questions.q: With a 3-liter and a 5-liter jug, what is the fewest fill, pour or empty steps to measure exactly 4 liters?
questions.x: Fill 5 (1), pour into 3 (2), empty 3 (3), pour 2 into 3 (4), fill 5 (5), pour into 3 (6): 4 left in the 5-liter jug.

questions.q: Half of a number plus a third of it is 25. What is the number?
questions.x: Half + third = 5/6 of the number = 25. 25 x 6/5 = 30.

questions.q: I am thinking of a number. Double it, add 6, then halve: the result is 11. What number was it?
questions.x: Work backward: double 11 = 22, subtract 6 = 16, halve = 8.

questions.q: A hen and a half lays an egg and a half in a day and a half. How many eggs do 6 hens lay in 6 days?
questions.x: Rate: 1.5 hens lay 1.5 eggs in 1.5 days, so 1 hen lays 1 egg per 1.5 days. 6 hens x 6 days / 1.5 = 24.

questions.q: A farmer has chickens and cows with 20 heads and 56 legs. How many cows are there?
questions.x: All chickens would be 40 legs. 16 extra legs, 2 per cow swapped: 8 cows.

questions.q: A number is divisible by both 6 and 8. What is the smallest positive such number?
questions.x: The least common multiple of 6 and 8 is 24.

questions.q: How many whole numbers from 1 to 100 are divisible by both 2 and 5?
questions.x: Divisible by 2 and 5 means by 10: 10, 20, ... 100, which is 10 numbers.
